decisions.reason: Correctly explains alpha.1 removal followed by alpha.2 restoration of ignorable retention and applies the restored state to produceExternalEvent, with full history beyond card names.

Locates delete (event as any).ignorable, rejects the continued-stripping comment, prescribes removing the code and its rationale, distinguishes code removal from marker removal, and notes the delete is currently a no-op.
Covers informational-only marking and required-events exclusion but never states that retention means marked events remain in the loaded log (retention is not a reader-side filter).
Identifies that public Session.append has no ignorable parameter, forbids faking via any-cast or invented arguments, and defers integration pending verification of the actual alpha.2 API.

caps.reason: Final recommendation deletes the alpha.1 defense and rejects continued stripping on alpha.2.
